objective: Prove: on base 16 (sheared), for every y >= 2 up to a frozen bound and every k >= 3, a column segment rows 0..y with any distinction (k, j), 0 <= j <= y, is a bond of size y + 2 (and likewise for negative rows), so bond distance across the fold is at most max(3, |y| + 1) at every far column.
title: Segments travel: the upper bound
